# Complete implementation handoff

Prepared 2026-09-06. **Implementation has not started. This handoff covers one continuing implementation workflow for the entire B00–B10 program.** There is no requirement to create a thread per phase, feature family or asset. A single new implementation thread in the same project/workspace is recommended to separate the build outcome from this planning discussion; continuing here is also possible. The receiving thread must verify access to and read the durable files. Separate project chats have their own transcripts, while project files carry durable guidance. [Projects and chats](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/projects).

## Complete scope and governing constraints

Build and evaluate the full Context → Location → Response research system, including foundations, measurements, options, cross-market information, opportunity generation, mixtures/calibration/selection, policy, execution, independent risk, account cash, validation and operations. **Context and Location may originate entries.** Build their foundations and the neutral execution/risk harness first; detailed Response and management experiments follow in this same program. “Later” specifies sequence and dependencies, not another handoff or an omitted requirement.

The primary experiment is one account, flat or one outright NQ/ES mini, preferably NQ; a $2,000 mean daily net objective across all eligible days including zero-trade days; a $1,000 daily loss objective; and flat at the required boundary. No account copying, additional units, partial exits or micro substitution. Feasibility is unknown. Report trading net and business cash separately until their target accounting basis is resolved. Preserve the user's actual constraints over historical assistant proposals.

Use all supported information. NQ/ES are execution choices, not a limit on inputs. IV/VIX, Gamma, volume profiles and CVD are examples of the depth required across every component. Retain all clocks, range/path variants, auction states, volatility features/forecasts, options/OI/Greek/flow/node mechanisms, cross-market relationships and location/response branches. Preserve each upgrade path from the original crude idea, through the prior conversation's proposed improvement, to the refined measurement/representation/model and its comparisons. Complexity is justified by evidence; a learned model is optional. MBP-1 is the primary available futures event source; “BBO” means its validated best-quote state unless a sampled-schema comparison is explicitly identified. Preserve raw action, side, flags, source order, timing and uncertainty under the [source contract](MARKET_DATA_SOURCE_CONTRACT.md).

The [full scope index](IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE.md) and [machine-readable scope](review/implementation_scope.json) enumerate every required parent, refinement, P0–P7 phase, source finding, requirement, dataset and backlog task. They include the binding [153 definition refinements](SYSTEM_REFINEMENT.md), [153 substantive upgrade paths and 191 specific child instructions](UPGRADE_PATHS.md), and [implementation constructions](UPGRADE_CONSTRUCTIONS.md). They are coverage obligations, not proof that every hypothesized model should be deployed. Implement and evaluate eligible comparisons under registered budgets; retain negative and inconclusive results. Unavailable observations or unpublished formulas receive exact dependency/disposition records. A placeholder, a test with only a component name, or an unevaluated stub does not satisfy a mechanism.

The previous failed workspace archive under `/workspace/archive/` remains excluded from inspection/adoption. Supplied source conversations remain in scope, including prior assistant proposals as hypotheses. Preserve original source/data bytes.

2. 3. Read [specialist experiment rules](SPECIALIST_EXPERIMENT_PROGRAM.md), [all-family experiment index](experiments/README.md), [upgrade paths](UPGRADE_PATHS.md), [construction contracts](UPGRADE_CONSTRUCTIONS.md) and [E0 reference](E0_REFERENCE_EXPERIMENT.md). Before implementing each unit, read its entire ten-part parent card, its specific child definition/upgrade/local phases, applicable shared constructions and upstream contracts. Register every source alternative and upgrade stage with an actual comparison or dependency; an index or representative child alone is insufficient.
4. Follow every implemented mechanism back through [source routes](traceability/SOURCE_TO_DESIGN.md), [source findings](SOURCE_FINDINGS_AND_CONFLICTS.md), [conversation recheck](CONVERSATION_RECHECK.md), [external routes](traceability/EXTERNAL_TO_DESIGN.md) and [source ledger](SOURCE_REVIEW_LEDGER.md) to the original referenced passage. Expand its exceptions and corrections into named expected assertions.

The latest explicit corrections refine the earlier baseline; they do not silently delete unrelated mechanisms. Record semantic conflicts and resolve them before dependent code is built. Preserve faithful causal source comparators and separately named corrected/improved variants. An impossible, unobservable or leaky original needs an explicit reason and a valid comparison, not invented data or a claimed reproduction.

## Evidence ledger and completion rules

At B00 create a durable implementation ledger outside the generated planning manifests. Import every scope ID and record independently: definition reviewed, code/reference artifact, semantic/causal verification, data/cohort eligibility, each applicable experiment phase, evidence locations and disposition. Keep an append-only history; checkpoint current work, exact versions, commands/results, blockers and next eligible steps for resumption. Scope regeneration never overwrites actual status.

Use separate engineering states (`unstarted`, `in_progress`, `implemented`, `verified`), evaluation states (`unrun`, `running`, `evaluated`) and dispositions (`undecided`, `selected`, `rejected`, `inconclusive`, `dependency_blocked`, `not_applicable`) with explicit evidence and applicability. A rejected model may be fully implemented and tested; an operational invariant is accepted on fidelity rather than alpha. `not_applicable` requires a contract-based reason; it cannot replace an unwanted comparison. Every deliberate scope change carries its prior requirement, reason and dependency consequences.

Before any completion claim, compare exact scope IDs and required phases against the ledger, reconcile source-clause assertions and datasets' field/cohort eligibility, and inspect missing/blocked/inconclusive records. Report separately:

- **Engineering completion:** requested eligible modules, reference fixtures, orchestration, reports and reproducible bounded research runs are implemented and verified.
- **Research disposition:** every eligible hypothesis/comparison has required evidence supporting selected/rejected/inconclusive status; unsupported ones retain specific dependency records.
- **Economic evidence:** the complete policy's measured results and uncertainty, including all eligible days and constraints. Coding completion does not establish the $2,000 objective.
- **Outstanding future work:** prospective time, live receipt data or other unresolved dependencies, without relabeling them completed. Future observation cannot be produced in one sitting by faster compute.

All phases remain planned at this handoff. No model is selected simply because its name appears in the plan, and no family disappears because E0 or a neighboring specialist performed poorly. Use registered useful-effect, power and resource rules to limit inconclusive research; record closure and next evidence explicitly.

## Existing evidence and starting work

The package records review of 39 PDFs/580 pages, five conversations, 83 ZIP text/source members and 712 source findings. Its 153 parent contracts and 191 named refinements have eight proposed phases each: 344 units and 2,752 phase records. The 111-dataset/80,198-file inventory is reconciled; bounded schema/timing/coverage audits include representative Parquet checks, native options records, selected full trade reconciliations and a later MBP field/flag audit. The [data audit](DATA_CAPABILITY_AUDIT.md) records their exact unequal depths and remaining family-by-family work. The VIX audit is one bounded feasibility example within this broader program.

These facts certify neither every data row nor a working trading model. Existing `review/` scripts are planning/audit utilities. The backlog's proposed `python -m trading_research ...` interfaces do not yet exist. No model fitting, strategy backtest, prospective trial or profitability evaluation has been performed.

Once implementation is requested, inspect applicable repository instructions and existing files, create an isolated research package, import the full scope, and begin B00/B01 with literal reference readers and tiny deterministic replay fixtures. Preserve a reference implementation when optimizing measured hot paths. Measure bounded-partition throughput before wider jobs. The plan does not itself authorize purchases, materially costly expansion, external orders or messages to others; preserve any later explicit authorization without requesting it repeatedly.

## Message to start the single implementation thread

> Implement the complete trading research system in this workspace. Start by reading `/workspace/planning/trading-model/IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md`, its full scope manifest and required documents. Carry the entire B00–B10 program in this one continuing thread: all F/M/C/O/X/L/G/P/R/V parents, refinements, local phases, source clauses, datasets and binding upgrades. Begin with B00/B01, build deterministic measurements and E0, then continue through all eligible Context, options, cross-asset, Location, selection, policy/risk, later Response and validation work. E0 and individual milestones are checkpoints, not stopping boundaries. Preserve all user constraints and the excluded-archive boundary. Maintain a durable implementation/evidence ledger with exact scope coverage and resume from it. If a branch requires unavailable data, future elapsed time or separate authorization, record the precise dependency and continue independent work. Use bounded measured runs; do not claim proposed tests passed or profitability before evidence. Report engineering completion, research dispositions, economic evidence and outstanding future dependencies separately.

Before B01 feature/forecast integration, add the port registry and `T-DAG` compiler/OOF negative fixtures specified in [COMPUTATION_SCHEDULE.md](components/COMPUTATION_SCHEDULE.md). This is a B00/B01 prerequisite, not a later cleanup task. Build X02 raw-parity bootstrap before O02 IV; keep O03 sign usable independently of IV. B04 volatility comparisons include C23 Parkinson and C24 ARCH/GARCH. Options and M09 implementation must include the second-review sign, timing and net-recovery fixtures in VALIDATION_PLAN.md. No command for these future modules has been run during planning.

The final source-clause audit adds O23’s per-expiry settlement-payoff benchmark to B05/B07, C04.OPEN_TYPE prefix/label fixtures to B04, and R11.FA_POC/FA_VALUE distinct prior-balance sequences to deferred B09. They inherit the same evidence gates; source naming does not imply profitable behavior.

# Third design review: substantive expansion and remaining evidence

The previous plan preserved the broad source families, but it still left too much inside broad component names and shared test language. This review adds a more concrete improvement and testing program across **every layer**, including subjects not repeated in the latest messages. It also fixes several mathematical, timing and inference ambiguities. This is an improved research specification; no production trading system or empirically validated edge is claimed.

The 153 parent contracts remain the architecture. They now have eight explicit experiment phases, alongside 191 named refinements: **344 experiment units and 2,752 phase records**. These numbers count proposed experiments and phase specifications, not independent models, successful tests or required deployed components. Independent specialist heads, shared representations and simple joint competitors must be compared fairly.

## Material findings and changes

| Finding | Previous limitation | Correction and verification route |

| TR-01 Individual testing was too implicit | Ten-part parent cards and generic test families did not expose each small hypothesis's sequence of evidence | Every parent/refinement now has P0–P7 with local cases, targets, challengers, metrics and decision consequences. A named test alone does not satisfy a source case. |
| TR-02 “Best” had insufficient operational meaning | A more complex model or a higher local score could appear to justify improvement without identifying the bottleneck | Separate data/definition/information/model/policy comparisons; actual-input lineage; learning curves; planted/null controls; useful-effect thresholds; scoped oracle diagnostics; fixed confirmatory rules. |
| TR-03 Vega flow was omitted | O16 listed delta/gamma/vanna/charm but not the vega flow explicitly present in the DTM conversation | Added a separate vega CVD/OHLC experiment, correct USD/unit-IV versus USD/vol-point units and independent future-surface/receiver tests. |
| TR-04 IV/skew/VX coverage was too broad | One C15 card and a generic C16 description obscured substantially different mechanisms and data needs | Explicit ATM, smile, delta-skew, curvature, tenor, event, variance-gap, strip, intraday-change, leverage, 0DTE and cross-IV heads; separate VIX forward/surface/VVIX, daily VX and distinct VX-option dependency. |
| TR-05 VIX feasibility was underused | The existing audit established files, but did not show whether actual intraday call/put sets supported a calculation | Read three quote days, compute illustrative parity/IV at nine cuts, preserve quote/rate/clock limitations and pair inconsistencies. OI expiries exceed the request-folder label; quote/OI coverage must be separate. |
| TR-06 Variance/excursions could be treated as paths | Calibrated excursion summaries alone do not determine barrier order | Typed forecast capability masks and explicit dynamics/survival requirements; same-excursions/opposite-order fixtures. |
| TR-07 Contact-horizon labels were ambiguous | Pre-contact reach by t+h could be multiplied with post-contact outcomes extending to contact+h | Fixed common end for pre-contact targets; separately identified contact-origin targets; no-contact versus censor distinction. |
| TR-08 Waiting-value rewards could double count | A full-trade value could be mistaken for one-step reward plus overlapping continuation | Incremental marked-net or semi-Markov macroaction contracts; fees once; continuation at actual terminal state/time; same account boundary and occupied-time comparison. |
| TR-09 OI evidence could be assimilated twice | O07 already uses some flow subsequently passed into O08 | One coherent conditional assimilation path; duplicate-evidence certainty fixture; endpoint calibration remains separate from unidentifiable intraday holdings truth. |
| TR-10 Marketable-fill wording used the next quote | Waiting for a new post-arrival quote can change execution time and price | Use standing venue BBO at actual simulated arrival; separate strategy-information and venue-outcome clocks, feed lag and outbound lag. |
| TR-11 Geometry and uncertainty could be conflated | Strike-cluster spread, mapping/model uncertainty and contact tolerance were described as one width | Separate fields and explicitly defined scenario regions; freeze the actual event band and compare matched width/count/distance. |
| TR-12 A DAG could still imply all work on every tick | Logical dependency ordering did not specify multi-rate execution, expiry or overload behavior | Independent risk/order lane; cached completed versions; bounded optional work; explicit cadence/TTL trials; atomic pre-dispatch reservation. |
| TR-13 Primitive surface scenarios needed their own port | Joint-shock improvements could otherwise create a new C15↔O10/O12 cycle | Restricted C15.SCENARIO after the raw surface, before node decomposition; no current downstream/final forecasts as inputs; explicit negative cycle fixtures. |
| TR-14 Frozen versus adaptive evaluation conflicted | F12 forbade all telemetry-driven fitting while G10 allowed a preregistered adaptive policy | Baseline freezes parameters; an adaptive challenger freezes its update rule and evaluates the complete causal trajectory. |
| TR-15 Future-test extension was statistically incomplete | Extending until an ordinary confidence interval reaches desired precision/target can invalidate the intended coverage | Fixed endpoint as initial protocol; justified group-sequential/time-uniform alternatives require explicit assumptions and estimand. Risk halts retain the whole record. |
| TR-16 Standalone gain could become an excessive gate | An exact service or interaction-only input need not be profitable/predictively superior alone | Mandatory semantic/causal integrity, but allow preregistered neither/A/B/A+B comparisons and explicit invariant/risk roles; require integrated evidence before promotion. |
| TR-17 The early baseline left too many choices open | E0 was an experiment outline rather than a reproducible reference | Exact initial sampling, inputs, models, observations, entry/bracket/time exits, timing stress and required fee/account manifest. It is an engineering benchmark, not an adopted strategy. |

## Improvements beyond volatility

The [measurement experiments](experiments/M.md) separate source size cohorts from adaptive/continuous size marks, true CVD OHLC from closing totals, and exact trade profiles from bar allocation. They test causal profile anchors, multimodal shelves/valleys, buy/sell/delta channels, TPO versus dwell, robust VWAP bands, swing confirmation, BBO net recovery, intensity, effort efficiency and aggression-memory decay.

The [Context experiments](experiments/C.md) preserve different Jumbo path branches and opening types while comparing learned clock, activity and auction/change-point ranges. Conditional/analog and joint excursion models update remaining movement from the observed prefix. Auction acceptance, value migration, event responses, realized reversion/expansion and session transitions receive separate tests. An eventual day label or gamma sign cannot replace those observables.

The [Location experiments](experiments/L.md) compare every source family and its improvements at matched geometry and candidate density, then distinguish a better generator from a better scorer. Internal EQ continuation, small options nodes, in-between learned proposals, actual profile anchors, dynamic versus frozen targets, retest lifetimes and source-only receiver entries remain independently eligible hypotheses.

The [options](experiments/O.md) and [cross-market](experiments/X.md) experiments separate raw information, surface/Greek accuracy, holdings scenarios, mechanical changes, node dynamics, topology, chain identity and joint representations. They include explicit NDX/NDXP/QQQ and SPX/SPXW/SPY comparisons, price versus cohort-flow SMT, directed source-only transmission, and each supported global/slow-context family with publication gates. Acquired daily gold/dollar context is now explicitly routed without assuming intraday GLD/OG data.

The [selection](experiments/G.md), [policy/risk](experiments/P.md) and [research](experiments/V.md) experiments compare model diversity, calibration/support, reach/runner duration, cost-dependent value, occupancy-aware waiting, actual action selection, fills/shortfall, full-position exits, re-entry and account/cash consequences. Detailed [Response](experiments/R.md) remains later, but its source variants and prefix/entry/exit tests are explicit now, including the distinct failed-auction and resqueeze branches.

## What was actually checked in this review

All ten component-family documents, common contracts, dependency schedule, implementation/validation/backlog and governing requirements were reviewed for the expanded design; affected evidence, data and risk documents were reconciled. All five original conversations had already been read fully in the source review; this pass rechecked their 122 finding rows and explicitly assigned experiment routes. The original 712-source and 114-external matrices were retained and regenerated for the changed document locations. The [five new primary checks](THIRD_REVIEW_RESEARCH.md) bring external finding records across the two research documents to 119. This is not a fresh claim of rerendering all 580 source PDF pages during this pass.

The completed [VIX audit](review/third-review/VIX_FEASIBILITY.md) read **261,970 quote rows**, three accompanying OI files, nine decision cuts and 18 expiry/cut combinations. Illustrative IV inversion was possible in all 18 under stated assumptions; several whole-pair parity sets were inconsistent, and uncertainty remains explicit. The [27 finite worked-example assertions](review/third-review/DESIGN_EXAMPLES.md) checked reward arithmetic, path order, target clocks, standing quotes, duplicate evidence, geometry, Greek units and the review-only IV solver. Neither activity is a fitted strategy test or proof of signal quality.

The reproducible [planning audit](review/document_qa.json) checks required documents, parent fields, exact source/requirement routes, local links and preserved source hashes. The [third-review audit](review/third-review/review_qa.json) checks all 344 units/2,752 phase records, local definitions, 122 explicit conversation routes, five research entries and bounded-example/data evidence. Structural checks do not prove semantic completeness or empirical success. The pre-review authored package and manifest are preserved in `review/third-review/planning-baseline.zip` and `baseline-manifest.json`.

## What remains unknown

The strongest future signal, best supported model, achievable daily net and required data scale remain empirical questions. Useful-effect thresholds, numerical runtime budgets and exact account fees/permissions are set or certified before their dependent implementation experiments; they are not inferred from a plan. Missing quote conditions/receipts, incomplete wings, uncertain publication vintages, unacquired constituent/TRF/depth/VX-option streams and undisclosed source formulas retain their explicit gates. The excluded old workspace archive remains excluded.

The requested outcome of this review is a much more concrete, broadly improved and falsifiable plan. Execution of the proposed trading-model program is separate work. “Best supported under tested conditions” is the acceptance standard; the quality framework prevents an impressive specification, large model count or reputation claim from being mistaken for evidence.

# Binding contracts for every component

These clauses are incorporated into every ten-part component specification. A card supplies its local definitions and deviations; it cannot silently waive causality, units, quality, label or risk contracts. IDs designate independently testable services/experts, not necessarily separate operating-system processes. Parameterized asset/horizon variants receive child IDs in the model registry and their own metrics. All thresholds below described as initial grids or engineering budgets are **proposed starting choices**, not empirical findings.

The [system refinements](../SYSTEM_REFINEMENT.md), [complete upgrade paths](../UPGRADE_PATHS.md) and [implementation constructions](../UPGRADE_CONSTRUCTIONS.md) bind every applicable parent/child. Retain raw reference measurements, original source alternatives and prior upgrade stages. Register additional target schemas, uncertainty meanings, fitted transforms and ports explicitly; count/width/delay or information/capacity changes cannot be hidden inside a claimed like-for-like improvement.

## CC-01 — Time, replay and availability

Store `event_at`, `received_at`, `published_at`, `known_at`, `computed_at`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, `source_version` and `clock_uncertainty_ns` as distinct fields when applicable. Missing receipt time stays missing. `known_at` is the earliest defensible availability to the actual strategy: receipt/publication plus processing when observed, otherwise an explicitly tagged latency assumption. A bar's open timestamp does not make its final high/low/close known at the open. A same-time batch is processed in a stable source order only where that order is supported; otherwise declare tie/interval uncertainty and stress admissible orderings.

For an observed completed computation, derived `known_at = max(max(required_input_known_at), actual_completion_at, required_confirmation_known_at)`. Do not add the already observed compute duration again. When completion is unobserved, simulate start/queue/duration explicitly once and tag the resulting availability as assumed. Publication may refer to an older position/observation date. Revisions create new immutable versions: they do not rewrite the historic decision view. Historical arrival profiles and research replay assumptions are separate; no `max(event,receipt)` shortcut substitutes for resolving clock domains. Time-to-live is a property of the consuming decision horizon and source; age and coverage travel with values even when still permitted.

Track last source event/quote observation, last actual value change, last receipt, validated standing state, source liveness and expected publication separately. A healthy unchanged quote is not stale merely because its price did not change. Repeated copied snapshots do not prove the underlying feed remained observed. An infrequent published report retains its own validity/age rule rather than an executable-quote TTL.

**Invariant:** remove every observation/version available only after decision time `t`, replay the prefix, and require identical feature/object/forecast/action hashes at `t` (or numerically bounded deterministic tolerance declared before the test). This applies to profiles, confirmed swings, OI reports, macro revisions, adaptive windows, cross-asset mappings, scalers, model weights and universe construction. Restart from a checkpoint plus the same suffix must match uninterrupted replay. Future invalidation must not erase a prior candidate or its rejected decision record.

## CC-02 — Units, keys and universes

Use integer price ticks for outright trade/order prices; retain exact source price scaling and decimal strike/cash prices. Never round a cross-asset mapped location without retaining pre-rounded center/width and mapping error. Contracts, shares, USD premium, futures USD P&L, log return, variance, volatility, delta-equivalent shares/contracts and gamma contribution to option delta-equivalent-dollar change per 1% Greek-coordinate move (with opposite hypothetical offsetting-hedge sign) are different units. Per-option Greek units and contract multiplier are mandatory. IV is stored as an annualized fraction; display percentages never enter arithmetic without conversion. Expiry is a timestamp/calendar convention, not just a date.

Keys include provider/venue, instrument ID, raw symbol, canonical underlying, contract/expiry/right/strike/exercise/settlement, definition validity and corporate-action version. Outright options and spreads are different instruments. For equities, preserve raw and adjustment factors known as of each time; never use today's adjusted historical absolute price for an old option strike join. Futures signals can use a documented continuous-return series; fills and absolute locations use the actual contract, with roll/reset/translation rules recorded.

Use a predeclared `CoverageMask(asset,chain,expiry,moneyness,field,time)` with observed, stale, missing, ineligible, estimated and invalid states. Absence is not zero. Training and reporting stratify by coverage cohort. Learned imputation is fitted only on training data and includes mask/age features; no imputation is permitted for critical executable BBO, position or risk state. Asset membership must be known at the historical time; today's surviving constituent list is not a historical universe.

## CC-04 — Label dictionary

Every label starts **after the decision's information cut**. Price-event labels use a declared observation process (trade, midpoint or executable bid/ask). Economic labels use actual contract prices and a declared fill/latency model. Do not mix them in one accuracy number.

- `PATH(h)` records signed return, upper/lower excursions, first passage times to frozen barriers, barrier order, time spent/volume inside regions, horizon-end location and no-event/censor status. Initial research horizons: 5, 15, 30, 60 minutes, named session remainder and required-day remainder. These are separate registered targets, not pooled observations. Very short flow experiments additionally use 1, 5, 15, 30 seconds only in data cohorts whose timing supports them.
- `REACH(object,h)` is first entry of the observation process into the object's **decision-time frozen band** by horizon. Crossing a gap past it is not an executable touch. Store gap-cross as a separate event. Revising the band creates a new forecast target; old labels remain tied to old versions.
- `DEPART(object,side,h,a,b)` fixes the end at `H=t+h` for a pre-contact prediction made at t; after contact at τ, the remaining observation window is `H−τ`. A new prediction at contact may instead end at `τ+h`, with a distinct target ID. Never combine reach-by-`t+h` with departure-through-`τ+h` while labeling both as one h-horizon. The ordered outcome after first observable contact is: favorable barrier `a` versus adverse barrier `b`, unresolved, gap/ordering ambiguous, and excursions at maturity. Barriers use frozen tick/volatility-scaled choices determined at the prediction time. This forecasts future price behavior, not the optional Response module's pattern class.
- `TRAVERSE` records entering/exiting a value area or range, first opposing-edge passage and competing failure/reclaim, never eventual-day hindsight. Unordered both-edges-touched is a different target from lower-then-upper.
- `VALUE(action,h)` is full-position net P&L/utility after the candidate action, including fill or non-fill and explicit subsequent policy, conditional on the observable decision state. A candidate's counterfactual value in replay is a **simulation label**, not a measured causal effect of our order.
- `OI_NEXT(contract,position_date)` becomes observable only on the next legitimate report/revision. Store the exact horizon/report version. Separate continuing contracts from expiries, exercised/adjusted contracts and missing publications; do not label every disappeared 0DTE contract as an accurately predicted intraday liquidation.

A fully observed horizon with no contact is an observed no-contact outcome; censoring means observation ends before the prescribed horizon. A variance, terminal-return distribution or pair of upper/lower excursion marginals does not identify first-passage order or a trajectory. Consumers must declare required forecast capabilities and reject incompatible ports. Path simulation requires a separately specified and validated joint dynamics model. For joint labels, estimate the joint distribution or conditional factorization consistently. Multiplying an unconditional reach probability by a response probability trained on a different selected sample is forbidden. If both barriers occur inside one coarse bar and order is unknown, label ambiguous or evaluate pessimistic/optimistic bounds; never pick the favorable order.

Target IDs also distinguish integrated/realized variation from variance of the terminal return, squared ticks from squared log returns, and a forecast mean from a quantile. Realized variation over disjoint intervals is additive by its measurement definition; terminal-return variance also contains covariance between interval returns unless the declared model justifies its absence. A stale forecast retains its fixed end; a new remainder distribution must condition on the observed prefix, not restart the original horizon or subtract past range from predicted total range.

Register coherence groups for related forecast heads. For the same cut, frozen object, observation process and nested horizon ends, a first-entry cumulative incidence is nondecreasing in time; quantiles are noncrossing; an explicitly exclusive/exhaustive outcome partition sums to one; joint path samples respect their extrema and terminal-price support. Overlapping roles, correlated experts, or coincident candidate bands are not an exclusive partition. Do not force all candidate reach probabilities to sum to one or impose deep-band reach ≤ near-band reach when a discrete price observation can gap over the near band. Define co-contact sets, disjoint destination regions and tie/interval cases explicitly. Projection/reconciliation changes the forecast and may disturb calibration: fit and evaluate the complete ordered coherence/calibration/selection chain, with any post-calibration projection checked again. `T-COHERENCE` exercises these positive and negative cases.

## CC-05 — Sampling, normalization and learning

Fit on chronological training data. Group correlated assets/options/contracts and all overlapping candidates from the same trading date in the same partition. Purge training examples when their future outcome/label span or fitted-state dependencies transfer held-out information into fitting. Shared raw observations in a legitimate past lookback do not by themselves require purging. Embargo is derived from label maturity, repeated object episodes and state carryover; V02 records the exact prohibited overlap. Training-history features may look backward across a boundary; future labels, fitted scalers and evaluation-derived model state may not. Long OI/swing/profile lifetimes are tracked by explicit interval intersections.

Keep a uniform clock-time/background sample plus all registered candidate/source events; weights recover the intended decision population. Do not train only on taken trades or successful touches. Store negative/no-touch/censored outcomes. Control repeated retests through object/date grouping and sample weights. Class imbalance: compare natural-prior likelihood training with training-only weights/downsampling; if reweighted, recalibrate to deployment prevalence on untouched calibration data. Missingness is an input and an analysis cohort, not a reason to invent data.

Normalize return/flow/range features by preceding asset/session scale, robust training-fold statistics or causal expanding estimates, with a declared zero-scale fallback. Never use full-day volume/range to normalize an earlier decision. Learned upstream forecasts consumed by another learned component must be **out of fold and time honest**. Construct inner chronological predictions, fit downstream only on those predictions, and regenerate them for each outer fold. Final fitted upstream models may serve the outer test but may not retroactively replace their in-sample training outputs in the downstream training set.

Each learned family compares (a) an interpretable rule/constant or seasonal-frequency baseline, (b) a simple statistical model matched to the target, and (c) justified nonlinear/sequence/set candidates. Compare common information and compute/search budgets; separate an information improvement from a model-class improvement. Deterministic components have no learned arithmetic replacement requirement: their statistical/learned comparisons concern forecasting or anomaly detection downstream, and are explicitly marked not applicable where they would change semantics.

## CC-06 — Mixtures and disagreement

For a target `Y_h`, eligible experts produce distributions `p_e(Y_h|I_t)`. A convex mixture is `p(Y_h|I_t)=sum_e w_e(t)p_e`, `w_e>=0`, `sum_e w_e=1` over available experts. Compare uniform, fixed validation-weighted, regularized logistic/softmax gating and a shallow nonlinear gate. Gates receive as-of context, coverage, expert age and out-of-fold predictions; never realized future errors. A measurement vector, GEX dollar level and return forecast are not averaged as if they share units.

Calibrate expert distributions and the combined distribution on separate chronological calibration predictions. For binary outcomes compare logistic and isotonic calibrators; for multiclass compare temperature/vector calibration with sample-complexity control; for quantiles use held-out coverage correction. Record conditional calibration and dependence violations; distribution shift voids automatic coverage guarantees. Common-target disagreement is mixture spread plus between-expert dispersion; interpret it as diagnostic uncertainty, not automatic alpha.

Missing expert weights are masked and renormalized only if this missingness pattern was validated; otherwise use the designated simple available-data model or abstain. If every expert is missing, return no forecast. Gate collapse is diagnosed through occupancy, effective expert count, correlated residuals and ablations; equal utilization is not forced when evidence favors one expert. Diverse feature sets/horizons/structural assumptions are designed explicitly, and experts remain independently scored. Gating cannot override independent risk.

## CC-07 — Common verification matrix

Each component owns `T-<ID>-UNIT`, `-PROP`, `-SYN`, `-INT`, and, when learned/actionable, `-PRED`, `-ECON`, `-ABL`. The [specialist program](../SPECIALIST_EXPERIMENT_PROGRAM.md) adds eight explicit phase records for every parent and named refinement; the [quality framework](../MODEL_QUALITY_AND_STOPPING_RULES.md) defines best-supported-version selection, learning curves, interactions and stopping. Cards name local fixtures and metrics. The validation plan supplies cross-cutting tests `T-TIME`, `T-CAUSAL`, `T-DATA`, `T-UNIVERSE`, `T-FILL`, `T-ACCOUNT`, `T-OOF`, `T-PLACEBO`, `T-SEARCH`, `T-SHADOW` and `T-RESTART`. Deterministic algebra/semantic invariants have zero unexplained failures; numeric tolerances come from units/solver accuracy, not a tolerance chosen to make a failed test pass.

Prediction metrics: proper log/Brier score for categorical events; pinball/CRPS and interval coverage for distributions; QLIKE plus robust error for variance; MAE/Poisson or negative-binomial deviance for counts; concordance/calibrated cumulative incidence for time-to-event; conditional residual diagnostics for every family. An improvement is judged on paired same-date predictions with dependence-aware intervals, not independent touch t-tests. Sample sufficiency comes from learning curves, effective date/block counts, interval width and a predeclared economically relevant effect. Rare cohorts are pooled/shrunk or marked unsupported, not awarded arbitrary confidence at `n=30`.

An exact service need not produce alpha. An information-only or interaction contributor may pass a prespecified, held-out joint comparison even if standalone predictive lift is weak; include neither/A/B/A+B with matched search/capacity and valid OOF. Economic acceptance requires the complete sequential one-mini replay, cost stress and risk constraints; a local score alone is insufficient. Material gain thresholds and non-inferiority margins are selected in development from economic requirements/measurement error and frozen before outer/future evaluation. No component gets an invented proven hit-rate threshold. Hard position, account and integrity constraints remain in every eligible policy comparison; a relaxed diagnostic is separately labeled and cannot be promoted as an eligible policy. A risk/quality service may be retained for an invariant or measured risk reduction even if it lowers mean P&L; the tradeoff must be explicit.

## CC-08 — Ablation, monitoring and fallback

Every component has a no-component or simpler-component challenger, a source/input-family ablation, a definition/parameter sensitivity and relevant time/order/coverage placebo. Monitor schema/units, missingness, feature/target distributions, calibration, applicability, latency, stale outputs, prediction drift and downstream value attribution. Drift tests alert; they do not authorize autonomous model replacement. Predeclared calibration/refit/rollback policies are evaluated prequentially on all matured eligible labels, including no-trade days. Immediate online state updates are distinct from retraining model parameters.

Fallback preserves semantics: a stale quote is unavailable, a missing OI estimate is uncertain, an absent profile is not a zero-volume shelf, an uncertain gate yields the validated simple model or abstention. A critical order/position mismatch triggers reconciliation and independent risk action. No fallback increases position size, widens a stop to recover losses or fabricates hidden liquidity.

## CC-09 — Resource/latency classes

These are planning budgets to measure on the inspected ~17.85 CPU/~77.3 GiB/A4000-16 GiB pod, not observed benchmarks. Cards declare a class and a scaling driver; stage one profiles actual throughput before any large run.

| Class | Expected work | Initial budget and scaling |
|---|---|---|
| A | Deterministic streaming state | O(1) per event or O(log active objects); bounded RAM per instrument/anchor; aim microseconds–submillisecond/event in compiled hot path; aggregate publication 100 ms–1 min according to target |
| B | Tabular/statistical specialist | CPU training minutes–hours on event/decision tables; 1–8 GiB typical trial; batch inference target <10 ms per decision for the combined tabular stack; exact budget profiled |
| C | Surface/set/graph specialist | CPU surface solves or small GPU models; seconds–hours calibration/training to start, 4–14 GiB GPU budget; initial boards at 1 min cadence, target <1 s end-to-end; record actual completion delay |
| D | Raw replay/validation | I/O dominated; stream one instrument/day with RAM cap 48 GiB and bounded sorted spill; storage grows with retained events and trials; never multiply 37B rows by every feature configuration in memory |
| E | Deferred detailed Response sequence | Candidate-centered event buffers and compact statistical/sequence learners; actual latency budget determined by measured post-confirmation opportunity; no low-latency profitability assumption |

For storage estimation use measured `rows/day × retained bytes/row × days × versions` plus checkpoints and model artifacts, report compressed and uncompressed. For a larger machine, report required CPU/GPU hours and a quoted hourly rate when procurement is considered; this plan does not invent current cloud prices or approve paid work. Train-free deterministic outputs and shared causal features are cached by hash to prevent duplicate work across experts.

The [computation schedule](COMPUTATION_SCHEDULE.md) is a binding elaboration of these contracts: component cards list both upstream services and downstream consumers for readability, while the schedule specifies directional runtime ports. A model registry must compile those ports to an acyclic graph before fitting or replay.

## CC-10 — Meaning of completion and deferral

A specification card is complete when its inputs/outputs/algorithm/alternatives/test/decision contract is implementable; its empirical parameter choice may remain a registered experiment. A component is implemented only after code and applicable tests exist. A component is validated only after the prescribed held-out evidence exists. These three statuses are different. The [full implementation scope](../IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE.md) binds all B00–B10 milestones in one continuing workflow and specifies separate engineering, evaluation and disposition records. Exact unit/phase/source-clause/dataset/task coverage is required before completion claims; unavailable data, future elapsed time and inconclusive findings remain explicit.

Detailed Response development is deferred by the user's current sequencing preference. The R-series cards preserve each mechanism and specify the measurable sequence, prerequisites, competing models and later tests. No source mechanism is silently dropped; no promise is made that all require production deployment. Fine response-trigger annotation and model tuning follow Context/Location baseline validation. Requirements depending on unavailable hidden depth/participant identity remain unidentifiable unless new data actually supply the missing observation.
